text:
alex: heads up — saw a routing fallback case that left provisional tokens on the ledger after a stream truncate. looks like fallback -> regional-cheap model produced confirmed tokens for a suffix we thought would be provisional.

sam: ugh. link?

alex: trace id t=rl-0x9a3f, session 9876. repro steps: start streaming on model A, client reconnect, router falls back to model B, short-circuit truncation during toolcall, client acks partial stream.

jin: that sounds like the classic fallback attribution gap. is the toolcall credited to A or B?

alex: to B (the fallback). but the stream ledger kept a provisional entry under A that never got cleared. UI shows a small negative reconciliation.

priya: can we attach the console UX screenshot? Right now provisional vs confirmed is a single column and it's confusing. we should show per-route provisional totals and the routing policy that caused fallback.

marta: agree. product idea: add a "routing-cause" tag to provisional sessions (values: primary, fallback, region, cost-tier). then we can filter in the billing table and highlight sessions older than X that are still provisional.

sam: implementation note — the router already emits route.decisions but we don't persist them to the provisional ledger. small change would be to add route.decision_id to the provisional row when the session is created.

jin: also want to call out toolcall truncation: when a toolcall is in-flight and connection drops, we sometimes emit a truncated tool step and we bill the toolcall as confirmed because downstream adapter confirmed token delta. need consistent semantics: either provisional until explicit finalize, or idempotent toolcall-confirm protocol.

priya: ux flow: console shows a red badge for "stale provisional" if provisional age > 2m and route-cause=fallback. clicking it would surface traces + route history and a one-click reconcile action (ops only).

alex: reconcile action should run a safe ledger scan and attempt to mark confirmed only if confirmed events observed; otherwise present a suggested credit. No automatic credits without SRE approval.

opsbot: ALERT: provisional_billing_anomaly detected (rl-0x9a3f) — diff: +12 tokens vs expected. severity: low -> investigate.

marta: telemetry change proposal: export a metric provisional.leak.count{route_cause,model_variant} and a histogram provisional.time_to_resolution. that will help prioritize.

sam: pseudocode for router change:
```
// on session create
provisional_row = ledger.create_provisional(session_id, init_prefix)
provisional_row.tags = {route_decision: router.current_decision(), route_policy: router.policy_name}
ledger.save(provisional_row)
```

jin: also add a middleware on toolcall adapter to mark toolcall as "pending_finalize" until explicit finalize event from model or backend. pressing finalize sets confirmed token counts.

priya: question: will this increase write amplification on ledger? we need to batch tags for hot paths.

sam: yes slight increase. mitigate with tag dedupe + small in-memory cache that flushes on finalize/timeout.

alex: ops question: if we add route tags, can we backfill for recent 7 days for quick analytics?

marta: we can try best-effort backfill using trace logs but some sessions will be missing. surface confidence score in the UI.

jin: dev task list: 1) router persist decision id (safe small change) 2) middleware toolcall pending_finalize 3) ledger tag schema + index 4) console filter + stale-provisional badge 5) telemetry metrics + dashboards 6) SRE-run reconcile job (manual)

priya: i'll draft a console mock next. alex — can you attach the trace logs into the ticket?

alex: yes attaching shortly.

sam: ok let's track in a single RFC. propose naming: "fallback-route provisional attribution + stale-provisional UX". assign owners: sam(router), jin(tooling), marta(metrics), priya(console), alex(incidence follow-up).

marta: +1. leaving a note to avoid auto-crediting customers without SRE sign-off.

opsbot: NOTE: incident created (#INC-2024-298) — assigned to sam.

alex: cool. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
